mission.title: The Useful Man
mission.description: Deal with a traitor among the Merovingian's guards and with the Zionites killing his programs, then report what Danielle Wright had to say.

npc.say: I imagine you'd like to get it as well, yes? Hm.... We'll see.

Missile attacks forced the General to retreat from his first foray into the zone, but we kept some of his men hidden nearby for just such an occasion.
Mm, we never did discover who fired those missiles...only that the flight recorders of the downed Sentinels showed a ship nearby, of the type used by Halborn and Carlyne.
What is it to me? Go off and kill.

phase.briefing:
Bah! I'm starting to think we have more leaks than old Zion. Not only did that pesky interface program run around freely in our chateau--it got into a training simulacrum, of all things--but, now that it's skittered off and things here are operational again, I learn that some of our guards are trying to sell us out to those who want the program for themselves!
I won't have it, {player}! Kill the traitor, Calvinia, or there will be no end to this shameful behavior.

enter.say: Not a whole lot of fun having to take out one of our own programs...but you just don't cross the Merv. Everyone knows that.

done.say: At least it's over with. I wonder who he was supposed to be selling us out to?

near.say: Wait! It's wasn't me! It was-- Ah, damn it!

phase.briefing: Zionites! Those nincompoops think they're going to get some answers out of us, do they? Hah! I counter with you, operative, who never gave anyone a right answer yet.

enter.say:
Flood's in fine fettle today; I suppose he's happy his phone connection's working and he can nag all his operatives again.
Not picking up a whole lot of activity in there... Wouldn't be the first time Flood's been a bit slow.

done.say:
Pff. Drama queen.
Well, great. Now we're back to square one again.

near.say: Sounds like a grisly scene. Better see if you can get anything out of him.

phase.briefing: Hm... If I didn't know better--nobody would pay you anything...not sure why I do--I'd almost think you were in cahoots with the cave-dwellers, {player}. Now, stop dragging your knuckles, and take care of them before they kill off all my programs!

enter.say: Got some actives this time--should be our cave-dwellers.

talk.say:
Hm? You're no Zionite.
I understand they helped Carlyne get what he wanted...for a time. Now, they probably feel that was a mistake, though I can't say that I blame them; I hardly knew better myself, then.
But in the end, Carlyne has been quite a bit more useful than he ever intended.

done.say:
Quite the cucumber, isn't she?
Hm... There isn't much we can do against her directly. We'd better let Flood know what went down.

near.say:
Whoa, override activation!
Aw, man, is that who I think it is? Careful...

phase.briefing: I might have felt inclined to give you a bonus if you'd actually managed to kill her, operative. As it stands, I'll settle for sending you to the Merovingian to explain your failure.

enter.say: Yeah, I know... I tell ya, sometimes I dream of the day when you're standing around with Flood, and some kind of disruption to the Matrix causes the usual friendly engagement protocols to drop, just for a minute or two...

talk.say:
Hm... Carlyne "useful"? He collapsed just moments before the woman appeared in that new guise of hers. It must have been her doing, non? Which could mean...that she did something to him in your world--that she was at the same location as he was.
Ah... And we know where he was to be found, eh? The Machine "no-fly" zone 800 miles to the northwest, as so helpfully pointed out to us by his foe, Halborn. If Wright has been there...
Yes, this could be very useful indeed. I will send a flight of the General's Sentinels to investigate.

mission.finish: So he told you that bit of hearsay was useful, did he? Hmph. He is, as they say, a generous man...
